results: Real WebGL2 canvas renders and changes across captured frames.
Pause freezes actual rendered pixels; Resume restores motion.
Scrolling the hero off screen pauses it and returning resumes it.
Changing reduced motion at runtime removes the canvas and preserves visible content and links.
No overflow, broken images or titles beyond two lines at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 pixels.
Mobile menu opens using synthesized touch, closes after navigation, and Escape restores summary focus.
With JavaScript disabled, the prerendered hero, both games, CTAs and native mobile menu still work.
Simulated missing WebGL2 produces the black static fallback without hiding the title or controls.
No browser exceptions or hydration errors in the tested paths.
